name: Merged fixes go live by themselves
author: wizard
description: On a box that runs the Agent Service from hand-deployed releases, every merge to main whose checks pass is prepared and deployed by itself within about 15 minutes (ops/wizard-agent-service-follow-main.py on a 5-minute timer). If that stops, Wizard sends one notification saying the box is behind and why. Read by the Agent Service (server/follow-main.mjs, /wizard/health follow_main). Nothing in the shell changes.
